[[Kirin Tor Shawl of Oppresion]] | previous = [[Fel Energy Irregularities VI]] }} ==Objectives== Return the news to Watcher Mahar Ba at Nethergarde Keep. ==Description== So, he desires to know about the Dark Portal, and the influx of fel energy? The demon's have been gathering for some time around the Tainted Scar, and have been using it as a safe haven close to The Dark Portal. With the increase of Fel Energy, there is no doubt that they have plans for the future. This future though, may not come for some time given what I have heard. Go to Mahar Ba, and tell him to gather the best of his kin, and to prepare himself, time ticks slowly. Now, begone, I have repaid his favor. ==Rewards== You will receive: *7850 XP *+750 [[reputation]] with [[Dalaran (faction)|Dalaran]] ==Progress== Yes? ==Completion== We must begin to prepare, and keep the magical energies stable, you have given us a great deal of information, and without you we would have been unable to figure out these clues and unearth the answers we need for our future. The Kirin Tor thanks you greatly for what you've done, please, take one of these rewards, it is the -least- we can for how much trouble you have saved us. ==Progression== {{Fel Energy Irregularities}} ==Patch changes== {{Patch|1.16.1|note=Added.}}
